title: SentinelCI Waivers v1
description: The waivers file `.sentinel/waivers.yaml` (YAML holding this JSON shape). Written by people through reviewed pull requests (the AI may only draft them), consumed by the release gate (B4). See docs/spec/SPEC.md section 6.4. The policy enforces the same rules as SC-005, plus two this schema cannot express: waiver ids are unique, and expiry is at most 90 days after the evaluation time.

id.description: Unique within the file; recorded in decisions as waivers_applied.

finding_id.description: Waive one finding by its fingerprint.

vulnerability.description: Waive a vulnerability (CVE, GHSA, OSV id...) in one package, whatever its version. Matched against the finding's rule_id, cve and aliases.

purl.description: Package URL without version, qualifiers or subpath.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time. The waiver stops applying at this instant.
